row.evidence: Metabase docs: "User provisioning with SCIM is only available on Pro and Enterprise plans"; Pro is $517.50/mo billed annually versus Starter at $90/mo.
row.notes: Still gated, but the SCIM plan changed: June recorded SCIM as Enterprise-only (from $20k/yr); the SCIM docs now say Pro and Enterprise, and the pricing FAQ says Pro and Enterprise are the same software feature-wise. Pricing is a base fee plus per-user overage: Starter $90/mo annual ($1,080/yr) with 5 users included then $65/user/yr; Pro $517.50/mo annual ($6,210/yr) with 10 users included then $130/user/yr. Per-user fields use the annual extra-user rates ($65/12 and $130/12) and ignore the base fee. SAML/OIDC/JWT SSO also start at Pro. SCIM officially supports Okta (users and groups) and Entra ID (users only); both are configured as custom SCIM apps, not catalogue apps. Deprovisioning deactivates; Metabase does not support account deletion. Self-hosted open source edition is free with no SSO or SCIM.

auth.token_source: Admin > Settings > Authentication > User provisioning tab (toggle on; token shown once, can be regenerated)

endpoints.notes: Only Users and Groups paths appear under /api/ee/scim/v2 in the OpenAPI spec.

operations.notes: PATCH /Users supports specific replace operations (activate/deactivate), not arbitrary patches. No DELETE /Users; DELETE /Groups/{id} exists. Group push works with Okta only.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated accounts cannot log in; their questions, models and dashboards are preserved. Account deletion is not supported.

filtering.notes: filter query parameter on GET /Users and /Groups; supported attributes not documented.

roles.how: Group membership via SCIM Groups (Okta); permissions are assigned to Metabase groups.

limitations.text: Only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID are officially supported; other SCIM clients are untested.
Entra ID provisions users only; groups are not created or populated.
Enabling SCIM disables SAML JIT user provisioning.
PATCH supports only specific replace operations, not arbitrary patches.

auth.notes: X-API-Key header; key permissions come from the group it is assigned to.

endpoints.purpose: Create or refresh SCIM API key (enables SCIM)

audit_log_api.notes: Pricing lists 'Usage analytics & auditing' on Pro; no documented audit-log export API beyond internal /api/ee/audit-app paths.

okta.notes: Configured through Okta's App Integration Wizard SCIM setup (custom app); no OIN listing at okta.com/integrations/metabase (404).

entra.notes: Custom non-gallery app with Entra automatic provisioning; users only. Entra tutorial URL 404.

fallbacks.notes: SAML JIT is on by default and is switched off when SCIM is enabled.
